title: NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutrient Estimation with Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.08054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. tldr: 提出了NutriVisRAG检索增强框架，通过视觉编码器检索视觉相似的已标注餐食作为多模态上下文示例来锚定视觉语言模型的营养估计，无需任务特定微调即可提升估计性能。
en_tdlr: NutriVisRAG is a retrieval-augmented generation framework that grounds VLM-based nutrient estimation on visually similar annotated meal exemplars retrieved by a vision encoder, improving estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning.
